description: Detailed Technical Specification Data of Battery-Electric Heavy-Duty Trucks Dataset (DT-TECH) is a data set described in the paper "Detailed Technical Specification Data of Battery-Electric Heavy-Duty Trucks Dataset (DT-TECH)" in IEEE Data Descriptions (IEEE, 2026), produced by Tom Winkler, Baris Atalik, Marcel Brodel and colleagues. This data article presents a dataset of technical specifications for battery-electric semi-trailer tractors available or announced worldwide. It forms part of a dataset series on truck electrification. The dataset comprises 102 vehicle configurations from 22 original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), covering the vehicle classes “N3” (European classification) and “8” (North American classification) for semi-trailer tractors with 4 × 2, 6 × 2, or 6 × 4 chassis/axle configurations. Coverage: battery-electric semi-trailer tractors available or announced worldwide. The data are held on Zenodo, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost: free of charge according to the repository record; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support freight electrification and charging infrastructure planning. Related record: the journal-level record for IEEE Data Descriptions.
